_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Score sits at the Anxiety/Complacency boundary in a documented coil; no ±2-point breaker is confirmed, so HOLD is the graded base-rate call until flows or F&G resolve.
next_move.brains_agree: partial split — analyst explicitly HOLD/Complacency; narrative silent on forward phase and only notes cross-asset rotation
next_move.confirmed_if: BTC remains range-bound, Fear & Greed holds ~42-55, and ETF flows stay absent
next_move.invalidated_if: ETF flows rebound with reclaim of the 30d high, or high-volume flush drives Fear & Greed through 39 with funding collapse
